title: Test expert gradients against matched numerical proposals
hypothesis: Assembly expert gradients can coordinate existing placement parameters more efficiently than independent numerical proposals when checkpoints are selected by rollout success.

prediction.against: baseline: five-candidate numerical search from each frozen D-020 assembly incumbent
prediction.rationale: A 10-point gain on fresh cases would show useful expert-guided parameter proposals beyond an equally rollout-selected numerical trajectory.

protocol.command: test "${APPROVED_ASSEMBLY_FITTING:-no}" = yes && gpu run -- python scripts/compare_generation_modes.py --assembly-study expert-fit-vs-numerical --source-decision D-020 --seed 3410 --out-dir logs/assembly_fitting_s3410
code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: add the stated study mode using fit_policy_with_objective, EXPERT_POLICY_MAP and the existing rollout_search sampler; retain the two frozen structures and their bounded parameterization without changing prompts or policy logic. Abort before simulator spending if fitting cannot preserve their semantics.

Freeze 50 development cases: expert demonstrations on 40-49, rollout selection on 0-4, and screening/promotion on 10-39. Collect ten SawyerAssemblyV3Policy demonstrations and audit their success. For each structure compare checkpoints 0, 100, 300, 600 and 1000 against five numerical candidates including the identical starting vector; evaluate all ten candidates on the five probe cases. Select only by existing success-then-progress ranking, then evaluate both winners on the 30 screen cases.

Budget is 10 demo episodes, 100 probe episodes and 120 screen episodes. Report paired success and intervals separately by structure and for the fixed two-structure average; promote only with a strictly positive difference and positive paired interval lower bound. This tests frozen assembly structures, not D-013's fit-ready prompting, and adds no fittable-lane parents. Require per-idea approval and stop the remote allocation afterward.

falsified_by: The upper paired confidence bound for fitted-minus-numerical success is below 0.10. An interval including zero is inconclusive; the resolving measurement is the same frozen winners' paired success on another fresh development manifest, not their imitation losses.
